claims.claim_ar: تشبيه بليغ بحذف الأداة: شبههم بالدرج في تفاوتهم علوا وسفلا، تشبيه بليغ بحذف أداة التشبيه.
claims.claim_en: An eloquent simile (tashbih baligh) with the particle omitted: they are likened to 'degrees' (steps), emphasizing variation (high and low); the simile is made in an eloquent/terser form by omitting the comparative particle.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Conveys gradation and diversity among the subjects, compactly and vividly; the omission of the particle increases immediacy and force.

claims.claim_ar: استعارة ممكنة: جعلهم نفس الدرجات كمبالغة في التفاوت (أي: جعلهم الدرجات لا مجازًا بل حقيقة تصويرية للمبالغة).
claims.claim_en: Possible metaphor (istiarah): making them the 'degrees' themselves as an exaggerated portrayal of variation — i.e., treating them as the degrees rather than merely likening them.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source presents both readings (simile with omitted particle and metaphor); the text supports either interpretation depending on rhetorical analysis.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Intensifies the sense of disparity among the referents by eliminating distance between them and the image (they become the degrees), heightening emotive force.
